title: An antibody finds its target
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: An antibody binding site can recognize a compatible epitope, a particular part of an antigen. Binding depends on molecular fit and other interactions.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: What does the binding site of an antibody recognize? An antibody binding site can recognize a compatible epitope, a particular part of an antigen. Binding depends on molecular fit and other interactions.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: What can an antibody binding site recognize? Antibody binding sites recognize compatible antigen epitopes.

recall.question: What can an antibody binding site recognize?
recall.why: Antibody binding sites recognize compatible antigen epitopes.
